infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: CourseCollab adds your class schedule to Apple Calendar and sends class reminders.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: CourseCollab adds your class schedule to Apple Calendar and sends class reminders.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: CourseCollab can remind you before class starts.
infoPlist.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: CourseCollab can remind you before class starts.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: CourseCollab sends class reminders, quiz deadlines, announcements, and course messages.
